worldFact.locationContext: Ellesmere Island, Nunavut · Canadian High Arctic
worldFact.fact: Alert, just 817 km from the North Pole, is the most northerly permanently inhabited place on Earth. Its roughly 55 residents get no night at all from early April to early September, then no direct sunlight from mid-October to March, through winters that sit around −40°C.
